title: Ab bhi aati hai Sakina ki sadaein logo haye zindanon se
body:
Ab bhi aati hai Sakina ki sadaein logo haye zindanon se
Meray Baba sey milaado Main duaein doongi,
Siskiyaan leykay jo kehti thi musalmaano sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolay Sajjad Sakina yeh muqaddar tera (x2)
Bey Kafan tujhko liye phirtaa hoon bazaaron mein
Aur lahoo aaj bhi jaari hai teray kaanon sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaakay Maqtal mein pukaari yeh Sakina rokar (x2)
Bhaiyya Qasim meray Akbar tum kahaan ho saarey
Meray Baba ko bachaalo aakay Shaitaanon sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab chali ghar sey teray saath sabhi thay Zainab (x2)
Aun-o-Mohamma-o-Akbar yaad aathay hongay
Lautt kay aati jo hogi tu bandhey haathon sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Labey darya sey Alamdaar ki aayi yeh sadaa (x2)
Aye Sakina tujh sey sharmindaa hai chaa-cha tera
Paani pahuncha na sakaa haaye katey shaanon sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaat Adhaanein bayek waqt fizaa mein goonji (x2)
Saani-e-Zahra kay khutbon ko dabaaney kay liye
Shor berpaa kiya darbaar mein adhaanon sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaem-e-Aaley Muhammad yeh hai Akhtar ki dua (x2)
Sachcha Hasnain ka hai Maula sadaa-e-matam
Hashr takh yoonhi sadaa goonjay Azakhaanon mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Baba sey milaado Main duaein doongi,
Siskiyaan ley kay jo kehti thi musalmaano sey
<<MINI>>
Ab bhi aati hai Sakina ki sadaein logo haaye zindanon sey
